title: The Country Girls
author: Edna O'Brien
current_text: The Irish censorship board banned The Country Girls when it was published in 1960 for its “sexually explicit content.”

sources.quote: When Edna O’Brien ‘s The Country Girls was published in 1960 it was immediately banned by the Irish censorship board for its “sexually explicit content.”
sources.title: Banned Books Week: The RLF writers who faced censorship - Royal Literary Fund
